title: Semantic note→note wiring validated: threshold 0.55, orphans 76→14, edges topically coherent
summary: Outcome of the semantic-wiring work (task #4). Embedding backfill: 130/130 notes now carry 384-dim vecs (was 33). autowireNoteProvider now scores via scoreMatchesSemantic (cosine over vec), allows note→note, skips done, top-5, threshold SEMANTIC_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD=0.55. Reconnection result on the live graph: note orphans 76→14, context edges 133→304 (+171), 178 note→note edges. Density healthy (max out-degree 6, max in-degree 6 — a web, not a clique). Edge QUALITY confirmed sensible by eyeball: coherent topical clusters (e.g. 'Editing orchestrator source: commit atomically' ↔ 'self-repo working tree is volatile' / 'worktrees are ephemeral' / 'autonomous loop builds in isolated branch'; 'Onboarding learning loop ran to plateau' ↔ 'Onboarding-KB value 14%→57%') — connecting notes that share NO literal keywords, which lexical 0.25 never could. The 14 residual orphans are genuinely novel notes with no semantic sibling ≥0.55 — correctly left alone; the 5-min sweep re-checks them as the graph grows (re-check, no independent-flag). Tests: all 23 files green individually incl. new score-semantic.test.js (13) and self-heal.test.js; whole-dir single-process run has a cross-test isolation collision (shared overlay/port state) — harness quirk, not a regression, flagged for cleanup. Agent was killed mid-report; work was verified independently post-hoc.
